caption: The drawing features a single hand tool set against a light beige or off-white background. The tool has a short, cylindrical wooden handle colored in shades of brown, attached to a metallic head rendered in muted gray. The head consists of a flat rectangular hammer side and a curved, pointed pick side. There appear to be two small, tan-colored rivets or fasteners on the top of the metallic part where it connects to the handle. To the left of the tool, there is a thin, faint vertical line with small marks, possibly indicating a measurement scale, but no numbers or detailed units are visible. The composition is sparse, with the tool oriented diagonally and the background left mostly empty.
title: Hand Forged Adze
